name: Coverage-DEV v1.1
role: DEV for candidate generation / decoder coverage; not a sealed test
provenance: hand-written by the ZaoSeq Bopomofo project; not rewritten from v0.1 TEST sentences and not modelled on any decoder failure case; word segmentation and proper-noun / colloquial tags are manual

leakage.method: char 4-gram MinHash LSH, Jaccard >= 0.6, Han-only normalized text
checked_against: v0.1 TEST-EVERYDAY and TEST-GOV (leakage check only)

reading_convention: MOE: 一／不 tone sandhi, particles neutral; CNS base tone when the neutral reading is absent
changes: cv19：「念」與「唸」在臺灣皆為通行寫法，新增「念」為可接受答案；v1.0 會把「念」判為錯誤。其餘 299 句不變。
